name: ml_ranker
description: PIT top-50 perps, 1d decisions: a conservatively regularised LightGBM model, retrained quarterly on a rolling 730d window, ranks next-H-day returns from ~25 cross-sectionally ranked price / volume / taker-flow / funding / crowd-positioning features; long top-k, short bottom-k, dollar neutral, vol-targeted.
mechanism: Combine many individually weak, fee-dominated cross-sectional effects (flow persistence, funding carry, crowd contrarian, short-term reversal, momentum, low vol) into one ranking so the combined gross edge clears the ~27 bp alt round-trip cost.
frozen_rule: config with the best MEDIAN within-fold train rank across walk-forward folds (tie: mean train Sharpe)

implementability_200.note: round_to_qty=True with load_bybit_instruments() on the stitched OOS weights; dropped share is an estimate (orders whose |delta notional| < max(minNotionalValue, minOrderQty*price) at the unrounded equity).

expectancy_units: USD per closed round trip on the $200 OOS account

causality.plus_walk_forward_guard: passed (walk_forward causality_checks=2 per fold raised nothing)

caveats: Crowd-metric features exist for 53 coins from ~2021-12 (~60% of the tradable top-50); the top-trader ratio is NaN for most of 2022.
Labels of names that delist inside the label window are dropped from training (the sim still books the delisting close).
Live needs Binance public data (taker-buy volume, L/S ratios, funding) for ~50 names plus a Bybit symbol map.
Downgraded: lgbm OOS Sharpe 0.38 does not beat the no-fit ew baseline 1.44
Rank-target models predict median rank (IC 0.12) but not mean return: the low-prediction names have fat right tails and negative funding, so the short leg gives back the edge.
headline: lgbm family (4 configs) walk-forward; trials counted over all 12 grid configs + 2 variants
live_retrain_cadence: model refit on the latest absolute 91-day grid close (anchor 2020-01-01) on the trailing 730d, embargo 2H; one refit per quarter; decisions daily at the 00:07 UTC run; no saved model
lightgbm: installed with python -m pip install --user lightgbm (4.7.0); native lgb.train API (no scikit-learn)

why_ml_fails_despite_high_rank_ic: OOS rank IC (Spearman vs next-1d open-to-open return) is HIGH for the fitted models: lgbm H1 0.127 (NW t 20.9), ridge H1 0.116, vs ew 0.030 - yet the lgbm book earns OOS Sharpe 0.38 vs 1.44 for ew.

Resolution: the rank target teaches the models to predict the MEDIAN, not the mean. OOS quintile MEDIAN next-day returns (low->high lgbm pred) -118/-71/-44/-32/-17 bps, but quintile MEANS only -35/-8/+4/+5/+11 bps: the low-prediction quintile (high-vol, recently-pumped alts; top gains r1, rv30, r60, vz30) has a strongly negative median but a fat right tail (squeezes/pumps), so shorting it loses much of the median edge on the mean.

The lgbm book PAYS funding (+8.5%/yr of equity) - it is short negative-funding (short-crowded) names and long positive-funding ones, i.e. anti-carry; with funding=False its OOS Sharpe is 0.70. The ew baseline RECEIVES 8.5%/yr (no-funding Sharpe 1.03).

The raw top5-bottom5 mean spread of lgbm H1 predictions is 55.7 bps/day OOS (t 4.7, before costs, unscaled), but it decays within a day (r1-driven): with no rank buffer the book turns over 205x/yr and nets Sharpe -0.08 (gross 0.86); with the pre-registered 2k buffer 113x/yr, net 0.27 on the frozen config.
Stops hurt: a per-name 15% stop re-armed daily cuts the lgbm OOS Sharpe 0.38 -> -0.10 (310 stop-outs/yr); 10% -> -0.41.

post_hoc_buffer_scan_not_selected.note: fixed lgbm H1 k5 over the OOS window, buffer multiples 1/1.5/2/3 (+ k10 buffer 1); 5 post-hoc trials, reported only

diagnosis.six_hour_variant: not run: the pre-registered condition was 'only if 1d works'; the ML models do not work at 1d, and their edge is the fast r1 reversal whose gross edge is already eaten by costs at daily turnover.
lab_notes: random_timing 'runs' null for the lgbm book: null turnover 215x vs strategy 299x/yr (lower, so that null is not biased low here); both nulls p > 0.10.
